scaleCalibrationReview.note: Manual protected cranial-plate measurements on two comparable right-profile poses per clip calibrate move, attack and death to idle; charge remains 1 within the five-pixel landmark uncertainty.

physicalAnchorReview.method: Manual per-frame review in original 1774x887 4x2 source coordinates. Anchor x equals the inspected ribcage landmark x; anchor y is the verified physical support floor including the three-pixel extraction guard. Medium confidence, eight source-pixel uncertainty; ten pixels for collapsed death poses. Source bounds and support types are enumerated in the linked scale review.
